name: mughal-pos
description: Offline-first cross-platform Point of Sale for tuck shops

scripts.smoke:db: npm run build:electron && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/smoke-test-db.js
scripts.smoke:ipc: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && node scripts/smoke-test-ipc.js
scripts.smoke:full: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && node scripts/smoke-test-full.js
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -n ng,tsc,electron -c cyan,yellow,magenta "ng serve --port 4200" "npm run watch:electron" "wait-on tcp:4200 && wait-on file:./dist-electron/electron/main/main.js && node scripts/electron-dev.js"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --win && npm run rebuild:native
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac && npm run rebuild:native
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win && npm run rebuild:native
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build -- --configuration=production && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir && npm run rebuild:native
